title: Participant Profiles and Sampling
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting participant profiles and sampling to moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Define a target population by the trait that drives the design's usability risk, not by convenience
Build a screener that recruits for that trait and excludes participants who would mask the problem
Use small-sample logic to choose a defensible number of participants per relevant subgroup
Span the range of learner variability so a finding is not an artifact of one narrow cluster

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
